question.text: The speed distribution for a sample of $N$ gas particles is shown below. $P(v)=0$ for $v\gt2 v_0$. How many particles have speeds between $1.2 \mathrm{v}_0$ and $1.8 \mathrm{v}_0$ ?

solution.text:
Hint: Total area under curve $=\frac{3}{2} v_0 a=N$ 
Area under $1.2 \mathrm{v}_0$ to $1.8 \mathrm{v}_0$ is $0.6 \mathrm{v}_0=0.4 \mathrm{~N}$
